title: Lentsoe la 'Nete la Mehleng ea Boholo-holo
intro: Ho na le moea ka hare ho Quran oo pale ea oona e phetiloeng ka litemana tse 'maloa feela, leha ho le joalo litšobotsi tsa bona tse ntle li khanya ka ho hlaka ho hoholo. Mohlanka enoa oa boholo-holo oa Mohau ea Hlohonolofalitsoeng, ea rorisitsoeng ke Ea Matla 'Ohle ka lebaka la bokhabane bo ikhethang, o na le sebaka maqepheng a tšenolo. Mosebetsi oa hau ke ho khetholla motho enoa ea ikhethang. Na u ka hakanya hore na ke bo-mang?
clues: Ke moprofeta oa Allah ea phetseng har'a meloko ea pele ea batho.
Allah o mpoleletse Bukeng ea Hae hammoho le baprofeta ba bang, bohle ba rorisoa ka bokhabane bo tšoanang bo botle.
Ke hlalosoa ke le monna oa 'nete ho Quran.
Allah o nthusitse boemong bo phahameng boo ba bang ba seng bakae ba bo fihletseng.
Lebitso la ka le boletsoe ho Surah Al-Anbiya, le kopantsoe le baprofeta ba bang ba babeli ba rorisoang ka mamello ea bona.
Ke Idris, moporofeta ea nang le 'nete le ea phahameng.

trial.label: Nyeoe/Ketsahalo
options: Ho boloka mamello le 'nete, ebe o phahamisetsoa boemong bo phahameng
Ho haha ​​​​areka e kholo ho pholosa balumeli moroallong o senyang
Ho lahleloa mollong o tukang le ho tsoa ntle le kotsi ka ho feletseng
Ho tobana le morena ea matla le ho hlola lebotho la hae la linohe
Ho phela ka hare ho mpa ea tlhapi e kholo botebong ba leoatle
trial.answer: Ho boloka mamello le 'nete, ebe o phahamisetsoa boemong bo phahameng

location.label: Karolo ea Bohlokoa
options: Sebaka se phahameng le se phahameng se tsoang ho Allah
Sekepe se seholo se hahiloeng ka mapolanka 'me se lahleloa ka sekontiri
Mollo o tukang o hotetsoang ke barapeli ba litšoantšo ba morena ea khopo
Leoatle le leholo le ileng la arohana litsela tse omileng
Mpa e lefifi ea leruarua le leholo botlaaseng ba leoatle
location.answer: Sebaka se phahameng le se phahameng se tsoang ho Allah

outcome.label: Sephetho
options: A amoheloa mohaung oa Allah e le e mong oa ba lokileng
Ba pholositsoe hammoho le balumeli bohle moroallong oa lefatše lohle
Ke tsamaile ka ntle ho malakabe a sa angoang ke mollo
O ile a etella pele Bana ba Iseraele ka polokeho ho ea tokolohong ho tšela leoatle
Ba kopane hape le lelapa la bona le ratoang ka mor'a lilemo tse telele tsa mathata
outcome.answer: A amoheloa mohaung oa Allah e le e mong oa ba lokileng

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
